user.title: Add a window
user.description: Pick the cover and enter the direction the window faces. Everything else has a default that you can change later in the options.

window.name: Window
window.description: The cover and the direction the window faces are enough. Every other value has a default.

data_description.copy_from: Fill this form with the settings of a window you already have (not its name or cover). Choose one and select Submit: the form comes back filled in, for you to check before you submit again.
data_description.preset: Fill in typical geometry: window height, glare zone, field of view, overhang and sun limits. Choose one and select Submit: the form comes back filled in, for you to check.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name of the cover.
data_description.cover_entity_id: The cover this window drives. A window drives one cover; a cover belongs to one window.
data_description.sensor_type: If you change the type, select Submit: the form comes back with the fields for that type.
data_description.set_azimuth: The compass direction the window faces, in degrees (north 0, east 90, south 180, west 270).
data_description.fov_left: Field of view angle to the left of the window center
data_description.fov_right: Field of view angle to the right of the window center
data_description.distance_shaded_area: Objects within this distance from the cover receive direct sunlight. Distance measured horizontally from the bottom of the cover when the cover is fully extended.
data_description.angle: Angle of the attached awning measured perpendicular from the wall to the ground
data_description.slat_depth: Depth of each individual slat in centimeters
data_description.slat_distance: Vertical distance between two slats in centimeters

sun_limits.name: Sun limits and blind spot
sun_limits.description: Optional. Ignore the sun below or above an elevation, or behind an object outside the window.

data_description.blind_spot_elevation: Any value equal or less is considered within the blindspot. Useful if the sun can shine over the object in the blindspot

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Optional. Position limits, covers that report positions inverted, custom position mapping, transparent blinds and privacy after dusk.

data.enable_max_position: Only force the maximum position when the sun is in front of the window
data.enable_min_position: Only force the minimum position when the sun is in front of the window
data.inverse_state: Inverse the state (needed for some covers that don't follow HA guidelines)
data.interp: Set custom open/close positions for My Cover, if it doesn't fully operate at 0-100%

data_description.max_position: Maximum adjustable cover position as a percentage
data_description.min_position: Minimum adjustable cover position as a percentage
data_description.interp_list: List of interpolation values, where 0 is fully closed and 100 is fully open
data_description.interp_list_new: Custom range of interpolation values, where the beginning should represent closed and the end open
data_description.transparent_blind: The blind is transparent and should always close fully when summer mode is active

exceptions_positions.name: Exceptions for this window: positions and glare
exceptions_positions.description: House-wide settings. Change them only if this window needs other values. Until house settings are available, each window keeps its own copy, which starts at the defaults.

data.occupied_distance: Distance from window to nearest seat

data_description.default_percentage: Default cover position as a percentage
data_description.sunset_position: Position to switch to after sunset
data_description.sunset_offset: Offset (±) from sunset time in minutes
data_description.sunrise_offset: Offset (±) from sunrise time in minutes

exceptions_schedule.name: Exceptions for this window: schedule and manual moves
exceptions_schedule.description: House-wide settings. Change them only if this window needs other values. Until house settings are available, each window keeps its own copy, which starts at the defaults.

data.manual_ignore_intermediate: Ignore intermediate positions during manual override (opening and closing)
data.return_sunset: Always adjust position to sunset default at end time; Useful if end time is before actual sunset

data_description.delta_position: Minimum change in position required before adjusting the cover's position
data_description.delta_time: Minimum time interval between position changes; minimum is 2 minutes
data_description.start_time: Starting time for each day; before this time, the cover will remain stationary
data_description.start_entity: Entity representing starting time state, overriding the fixed start time set above. Useful for automating the start time with an entity
data_description.manual_override_duration: The duration of manual control before resetting to automatic control
data_description.manual_override_reset: Option to reset the manual override duration after each manual adjustment; if disabled, the duration only applies to the first manual adjustment
data_description.end_time: Ending time for each day; after this time, the cover will remain stationary
data_description.end_entity: Entity representing ending time state, overriding the fixed end time set above. Useful for automating the end time with an entity

exceptions_climate.name: Exceptions for this window: climate
exceptions_climate.description: House-wide settings. Change them only if this window needs other values. Until house settings are available, each window keeps its own copy, which starts at the defaults.

data.outside_threshold: Minimum outside temperature for summer mode

data_description.climate_mode: Use temperature, presence and weather to decide between blocking the sun and letting it in.
data_description.outside_temp: Overrides outside temperature from weather entity if both are set
data_description.presence_entity: Entity representing room or home presence status
data_description.lux_entity: Use lux sensor to determine if cover should reduce glare in presence mode
data_description.lux_threshold: Threshold for lux sensor, above this value glare should be reduced
data_description.irradiance_entity: Use irradiance sensor to determine if cover should reduce glare in presence mode
data_description.irradiance_threshold: Threshold for irradiance sensor, above this value glare should be reduced
data_description.weather_entity: Monitors weather conditions, and outside temperature
data_description.weather_state: Choose weather conditions that indicate the possibility of direct sunlight.

settings_differ.title: {window}: the house settings differ from its own settings
settings_differ.description: {window} still runs on its own settings. The house, floor and room settings that will replace them in a later version give a different value for: {keys}. Nothing changes yet. Set these options back, or tell the maintainer, so the switch-over keeps the window as it is. This notice goes away when the values agree again.
